{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially after sentiment > 0.00).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.00) or trending downward.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10%.",
    "Increase downward bias when true outcome is consistently below forecast over 3 consecutive days.",
    "Lag correction: if true outcome is below forecast by > 3% for 5+ days, reduce next forecast by 2-5%.",
    "Avoid overconfidence in high sentiment periods — cap forecast growth to 3% per day if sentiment > 0.50.",
    "When sentiment is 0.00, use 30-day moving average as baseline, then adjust ±2% based on volatility."
  ]
}
